sections.label: Head
sections.text:
Sensation of a band around head; cannot
keep hat on. [Carbol. ac.] Skin of forehead tense.
Fear of falling when standing up. Violent vertigo, as
if everything turned around. Buzzing in ears; better
in open air.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Cough, with burning and pricking in
respiratory tracts. Weak voice.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Urine smells strongly of violets.

010 PRIMULA VLRIS — PRIMULA URCONICA

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Right axillary muscles painful.
Weight and lassitude in limbs, especially the shoulders.
Burning in hollow of right hand. Drawing pain in
thumb and big toe
